name: Gyro.finance
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.99). Replaced keyword guess "bridge-crosschain".
rootCause: The Gyroscope GYD L1 CCIP Escrow contract on Ethereum was exploited for approximately $700K due to an arbitrary call vulnerability in the _ccipReceive() handler. The function executed an incoming cross-chain message's recipient and data fields via a low-level functionCall() with no validation on the target address or calldata contents. An attacker sent a CCIP message from Arbitrum carrying only 1 wei of GYD, but with the recipient field set to the GYD token contract address and data encoding an approve(attacker, 2^256-1) call. Because the escrow blindly forwarded this call to the GYD token contract in its own context, the attacker obtained an unlimited token allowance over the escrow's entire GYD balance (~6.1 million GYD). A second transaction then called GYD.transferFrom(escrow, attacker, totalBalance) to drain all funds. Restricting the recipient field to exclude the GYD token contract itself would have prevented the exploit. Attack Tx: 0x51c22898a9b9f519a10b0a0be89b9d51c0248adb80cc0f89e57437e15e6c60c7 Analysis: DARKNAVY — Gyro Finance CCIP Escrow Exploit
